name: Horst Sheet Metal Inc
old_description: Are you a designer, contractor or homeowner who desires a truly unique look or custom finish for your kitchen?
about:
Horst Sheet Metal Inc operates from New Holland, Pennsylvania, in Lancaster County. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials, and no founders are named on its website.

The shop specializes in light-gauge custom metal fabrication, blending traditional handcrafted techniques with CNC machining and laser cutting. It produces kitchen accents such as stainless cabinet doors, copper sinks, backsplashes, range hoods, and countertops; roofing components including architectural moldings, ES-1 edgings, gutters, and downspouts; and HVAC parts like ductwork, fittings, adapters, wall caps, and piping. The facility also replicates historical moldings and finials for restoration projects. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include homeowners, contractors, kitchen manufacturers, designers, and architects. The company serves residential construction, commercial roofing, HVAC installation, historical restoration, and custom kitchen design sectors.

Horst Sheet Metal emphasizes its Lancaster County craftsmanship heritage, combining generational hand skills with modern automation. It markets environmentally friendly products made with a high percentage of recycled materials and promotes fast turnaround, attention to detail, and friendly service as operational differentiators.
